reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: L1₂ precipitation in the fcc phase of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 is well-documented, and the proposed mechanism of dislocation pinning and back-stress enhancement is a credible route to simultaneous strengthening and ductility improvement.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: TEM characterization of precipitates and comparative tensile testing would directly falsify the hypothesis if strength and ductility do not improve together.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, targeted hypothesis that addresses the core challenge of room-temperature brittleness in eutectic high-entropy alloys with a practical, single-intervention heat treatment.
